The Blockchain & Digital Trust ground truth in Fashion & Luxury: Fashion and luxury sell scarcity, story and service: assortment risk (the size-curve problem), authenticity, clienteling quality and channel consistency. Technology must be invisible, but the intelligence beneath it decides which drops pay.

Underneath authenticity contested sits the same story every time: decisions assembled by hand at a scale that stopped making sense. The first artifact of any engagement here is the measurement that proves it.

Inside Fashion & Luxury, Achala runs Blockchain & Digital Trust under the same delivery standard as every engagement: Achala builds pricing, assortment and store-operations decision systems under PCI DSS — decisions per store, per day, measured on margin. The baseline is signed before delivery starts.

What the regime expects of you

The Blockchain & Digital Trust control frame for Fashion & Luxury: GDPR (client profiling duties); Product-regulation (materials) (claims duties); Import/customs rules (authenticity documentation). Controls are designed against these duties up front, identity, access, retention and explainability are architectural decisions here, not audit-season retrofits.

The Blockchain & Digital Trust diagnostic in Fashion & Luxury comes before the contract: authenticity contested gets baselined in two weeks; if the delta is real, the build gets scoped; if it is not, you keep the measurement design either way.
